title.native: 日本へようこそエルフさん。

106663.description:
Serialization of the Syosetu web novel with the same title.

Kazuhiro Kitase's main hobby is sleeping. Ever since he was young, he would enter a world within his dreams and go on exciting adventures. As he grew older, he became acquainted with a female Elf and the two have now been united through a Dragon's brand! As he wakes up one day, he notices a familiar figure sleeping next to him...the Elf girl from his dreams?! Join Kazuhiro on his new adventures through Japan with the lovely Ms. Elf!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.native: 日本へようこそエルフさん。

106664.description: Two men's strange everyday parenting begins! A mysterious child appears before a bookstore employee and asks for his help to search for a god. However, this child isn't quite as human as he seems.
synonyms: Mo fumo fu no kami-sama sagashi

title.native: もふもふの神様さがし

106665.description: A renegade television producer strikes out on his own to produce a variety show and hires a gifted singer – one who is very ugly but turns beautiful if she fasts. Now add an undead boyfriend (made that way by the television producer) and an international singing star.
synonyms: Ue wo Shita e no Dilettante

title.romaji: Ue wo Shita e no Jiretta

106666.description:
A year has passed since Chikashi and Tomoaki, once a manager and his trainee, became a couple. They've started living together, having overcome Tomoaki's transfer to another department and a near break-up. However, Tomoaki is now being transferred to another office entirely. As they embark on a long-distance relationship, will their feelings for each other remain the same...? "It's because he's so precious to me that I want to respect his life."

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: The Future of Love Between He and I

title.english: Me, My Boyfriend, And the Future of Our Love
title.romaji: Ore to Kareshi no Koi no Hate

106667.description: Shiori Michishige has always dreamed about meeting her "fated lover." During the spring break preceding her first year of high school, Shiori starts dating Itsuki Karusawa. Although she thought she had finally met her destined soulmate, Itsuki cheats on Shiori and the two break up. Shiori then makes her high school debut with every intention of finally finding her true destined lover and take revenge on her cheating ex-boyfriend... but Itsuki happens to be in the same class!?

106668.description: Comedy depicting the daily life of four sisters: Shiki the JS, Mitsu the JC, Nino the JK, and Ichiha the OL.

106669.description: In the gymnasium of a particular boarding school, singing a song had special meaning...

106670.description:
Xiao Lang was a young man blessed with a powerful Mystic Soul, but others failed to see its potential. Ridiculed and persecuted for his ""useless"" Soul, he had no choice but to break away from his clan. He would not let anything keep him from achieving his glorious destiny."Even if heaven itself tries to stop me, I'll break through it! Nothing will stand in my way!" Favorite

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

106671.description:
Little Geuroo was curious about him. That boy from next door who asked him a strange question. The boy, Lee Garam, who always avoided him even though all Geuroo wanted was to get close to him. But before Geuroo could even confess, Garam disappeared in thin air, leaving only clusters of blue light behind. And then, one summer, he appeared in front of Geuroo as if nothing happened...?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Note: Part of Kidari Entertainment's "Yeoreumdanpyeonseon: Some in Summer (~키다리이엔티 여름단편선~ 썸인썸머, Kidari Entertainment Summer Short Story Collection: Some in Summer)"

106672.description:
It's whimsical, it's supernatural. It has foxes. It's beautiful.

1. Haru no Hitoe (春の一重)
2. Natsu wo Sasu (夏を刺す)
3. Aki no Collection (秋のこれくしょん)
4. Fuyu no Tsudoi (冬の集い)
5. Kodama (こだま)
6. Hiyodori no Saiban (鵯の裁判)
7. Adabayashi Dai-san Kouen (あだばやし第三公園)
8. Kagami no Naka (鏡のなか)
9. Benri na Hito-tachi (ベンリな人たち)
10. Canaria Koujou Nite (カナリア工場にて)
11. Tomoshibisou (トモシビソウ)
12. Oyasuminasai no Mahou (おやすみなさいの魔法)
13. Hoshi to Minarai (星と見習い)
14. Hari wo Utsu (はりをうつ)

106673.description: A story about a gardener and his assistant and the little people who live among the flowers.
synonyms: In that garden there was a "little" secret

title.native: 草かんむりと嘘つきの庭
title.romaji: Kusa Kanmuri to Usotsuki no Niwa

106677.description:
He stood at the pinnacle of the world. Surpassing all since birth in the art of the sword. But fate has left him crippled moments before reaching the apex. But the story continues and the legend will rise again...

(Source: Mangatoon)

106679.description: The story of a guy whose junior suddenly turned into a man one day.
synonyms: My Cute Junior Turned into a Guy

title.native: かわいい後輩が男になった話
title.romaji: Kawaii Kouhai ga Otoko ni Natta Hanashi

106680.description:
Sold off by her mother, a young girl winds up in the house of the empire’s most feared duke, Ein Castielo. Given the name Estelle, she must come to terms with her family, demon-lineage, and new standing in high society. But what will happen to the innocent Estelle when the enemies of the duke learn of her existence? Does she really have what it takes to be a child of the great and powerful Castielos?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Am a Child of This House
ある日、私は冷血公爵の娘になった

106681.description:
A conspiratorial relationship, an arranged plane crash. She forgot her past, but met the love of her life. The man said: You are my kitten from now on! Maybe this is destiny!

(Source: WeComics)
synonyms: The Diary of Loving a Forgetful Sweet Wife

title.romaji: Shi Yi Jiao Qi Chongai Ji

106682.description:
A boy who turned 15 years old, Kai meets a girl Alice of CS (card security) and is assigned to the eighth division of the central police "Recht".

(Source: Doki Doki Visual)

106683.description:
Kinema can't stand uncleanliness. This is why she was bullied by classmates and trapped in an infamous 'garbage' house.

But whilst there, she meets a boy inside...

Includes 7 bonus chapters.
synonyms: This Love Cannot Be Any More Beautiful.

title.english: Spotless Love: This Love Cannot Be Any More Beautiful.
title.native: この恋はこれ以上綺麗にならない。
title.romaji: Kono Koi wa Kore Ijou Kirei ni Naranai.

106684.description:
I'm K, my daughter was raped and killed by dregs but they twisted all the truths and, in the end, my daughter became the one who's to be blamed. The police are afraid of them, the law can't control them, then I'm going to clean those dregs for good. I'm K, you are the next to be terminated!

A moving and touching story about a father seeking revenge for his own daughter.

(Source: MangaToon)

106686.description:
Tottori Kenichi is a highly competent vet that has been nicknamed "Dolittle." He's very strict with pet owners and the money they owe him, but he really is a great vet. Often, he ends up not only helping the pet, but also the owner. The manga starts off when a young woman, Tajima Asuka, asks him to treat a racehorse, Asuka Mirai, who has a broken leg. She accepts the high cost of treating the horse, but is shocked by the level of suffering the horse will have to endure to in order to heal. [tethydsust]

(Source: MangaHelpers)

106688.description:
Based on the self-published webcomic initially released on Pixiv.

Meet Lily. A succubus, she is tasked with finding men every day, taking control of their dreams to steal their vitality. In return, Lily will fulfill any desires they have, no matter how perverted they are. And as the succubi population rate decreases, Lily finds herself more and more overworked in order to reach her rising quota.
One day, she enters the domicile of an exhausted corporate wage slave. Lily promises to make the man's wildest dreams come true, but what he asks for shocks her.

Note: Chapter count includes 1 extra.
synonyms: Tales of the Corporate Slave Succubus
Sukkub i jej ciężka praca w korpo

106689.description:
I Saw It is a biographical piece following the life of Nakazawa from his youngest days in post-war in Hiroshima up until his adulthood. I Saw It became the predecessor for Nakazawa's popular manga series Barefoot Gen.

(Source: Wikipedia)
synonyms: I Saw It: The Atomic Bombing of Hiroshima
I Saw It: A Survivor's True Story of the Atomic Bombing of Hiroshima

106691.description:
A young jaguar named Bagi has been the local terror for years, ever since a local hunter killed his mother for poaching.

Now a big game hunter has been offered a lot of money to track him down, and unexpectedly gets a tool to actually talk with him…

106692.description: A veterinarian is able to talk to animals, and uses his gift to help and save as many lives as possible, no matter what.

106693.description:
Arioka Yukihiro. 17 years old. A third-year high schooler. He is capable of handling things well and has good looks. That’s why he takes things for granted, knowing that it will end satisfactorily for him. Until…

Mishima Makoto. 26 years old. A teacher. He lives his life diligently, sincerely, and while holding on to unspoken feelings.

106694.description:
Arioka Yukihiro. 17 years old. A third-year high schooler. This is the first time I’ve seriously fallen for anyone. I wanted to make Sensei mine, so I forcefully took him.

Mishima Makoto. 26 years old. A teacher. I’ve always had hidden feelings for my close friend. I thought it was a love that could only end with me giving up.

Mishima, who once refused the selfish Arioka, began seeing his own unrequited love because of Arioka, who was not afraid of showing his feelings even if it meant getting hurt.

106695.description:
The Western Kingdom of Fortinu is in a dire situation due to the incursion of the Demon Lord. The captain of the female knights, Klinfeid, fearful of her body being sullied and the long history of the House of Laz being smeared, decides to kill everyone including herself before the orcs get to them! However, the newly appointed princess Luka is having none of that, and decides to run away from the female knights. What will happen to her?!

Based on an RPG.
synonyms: The Female Knight Says "My Princess, You Must Die"
"My Princess, You Must Die!" said the Female Knight

title.native: 女騎士「姫には死んでいただきます。」
title.romaji: Onna Kishi "Hime ni wa Shinde Itadakimasu."

106696.description:
1. Sakura Saku! (さくら咲く!, Blossoming Sakura!)
2. Kokoro no Kanzume (ココロノカンヅメ, Canned Heart)
3. Oomiya Mari no Geboku (大宮茉莉のゲボク, Oomiya Mari's Manservant)
4. Beachside Angel (ビーチサイド・エンジェル)
5. Desire
6. HENTAI GIRL
7. Medical Heaven (メディカルヘブン)
8. Kimi no Focus (君のフォーカス, Focusing on You)
9. Love Attack No.1 (ラブアタックNo.1)
10. Binyuu Dynamite (微乳ダイナマイト, Flat Dynamite)

106697.description: The adventures of the world's strongest, noblest Boss Bunny and his two wolf sidekicks!

106700.description:
The brand new "Glasses manga", made by the age when every second Japanese citizen has to wear glasses.

A mysterious bespectacled beauty in kimono and with a passion for glasses picks the best pair capable of changing your life.

106703.description: Haru, a rookie manga artist, stops at a mysterious coffee shop one day. ​The shop which opens only at night was run by a vampire and its regular customer is a wolfman! Haru begins visiting the coffee shop to listen to stories from the owner as a reference to his manga.

106704.description: The story of what happened to Iwase Yuutarou after he finally decided to give up on his brother and move on with his own life.

106705.description: Daily life of difference species that once existed or currently exist on the earth to deliver fun lessons to readers along with unique animal characters.

106706.description:
Usami Nagisa is a yankee who suffers from a rare disease which causes her health to decline if she feels lonely. Sewa Natsuhito, the boy who sits next to her in class realizes this and keeps her company, but the only way Usami believes she can cure her illness is to make lots of friends, a process she might find quite difficult due to her aggressive looks and personality.

Includes 4 bonus chapters.

title.native: うさみさんは構われたい！

106707.description:
A story about the clumsy period of adolescence where boys' and girls' have sex on their mind.

Print edition includes a special prologue chapter and the final chapter "Bunkasai."

106708.description: A short story inspired by Kenji Miyazawa's novel "Night on the Galactic Railroad"

title.native: 妄想文学-銀河鉄道の夜-
title.romaji: Mousou Bungaku: Ginga Tetsudou no Yoru

106709.description: The story of a boy, a beautiful black-haired literary club member, and the peculiarities of puberty.

106710.description:
They showed up out of nowhere. Graffiti that moved as if they were alive. People started calling them the "living pictures" and they started getting praised and sold for high prices. The origins are unknown and no one knows who said it first, but people say they are being created by someone named "Kilroy".

Enter Suzume, a young artist who aspires to create great art just like Kilroy but has been struggling to do so. One night, her everyday life takes a sudden turn as she comes across none other than Kilroy himself.

106711.description:
Popular bad-boy voice actor Shogo ends up starring in a radio show with the serious Yu, an up-and-coming voice actor. Yu seems to dislike him despite them never having met before... ?Yu's dislike stems from a drunken night where Shogo forced a kiss on him, then completely forget about it. Shogo takes Yu to a hot spring to try and make amends, but things heat up more than he expects...! Featuring handsome comedian Takafumi and hot-and-cold boyfriend Kazumi's second attempt at a hot spring trip, as well as the comedy duo couple! In the previously unpublished story, the ever-serious Yu worries over his flat chest.

(Source: Renta!)

106712.description:
Wataru, who tends to get teased by others, is dating Norihisa, the most popular up-and-coming voice actor. Norihisa sometimes gets in the way of Wataru's attempts to perfect his devilish charms for a new role, and the two often bicker, but they enjoy their sweet life together. But one day, Norihisa suddenly starts avoiding him...! The fourth installment of the "Voice" series!

(Source: Renta!)

106714.description:
19-year-old Nana is a good-looking, popular college student who'd like nothing more than to keep rumors of his prowess in the bedroom alive. He has a secret, though: his age equals the number of years he hasn't had a girlfriend! In other words, he's completely inexperienced!! Nana's so committed to living up to the idea others have of him that he can't even say he likes sweetened coffee. His classmate, Akira Mizuno, doesn't even try to hide the fact that he's gay, and Nana's drawn to Akira's unapologetic way of living life while being true to himself... Will Nana's first love ever bear fruit, and will he be able to lose his v-card without mishap!? This is a cute and sexy romantic-comedy about popping your cherry!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 童貞ナナくん☆フォーリンラブ

106715.description:
A couple in love, thinking about marriage, have a tough decision ahead of them. They might have to move in with Tomoya's father. However that isn't even the start of the problem, upon showing up at his father's house, Kanako realizes that not only does she know his father... but she has slept with him... multiple times.

Note: A live-action AV adaptation (URE-051) was released on September 7th, 2019.
synonyms: A Woman Like I'd Never Seen Before

title.native: 俺が見たことのない彼女
title.romaji: Ore ga Mita Koto no Nai Kanojo

106716.description:
In order to try to forget her unrequited love for her stepfather, Amane-chan goes out with every boy who confesses to her, until one day she tries to sleep with the playboy Hatsuki ... Could Amane forget her stepfather and love again?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

106717.description: The dutiful highschool student Minato has financial problems. While his mother is in a hospital and his brother takes care of the siblings, Minato has decided to earn money for the family. A newspaper ad promises a lucrative job as a housekeeper. However the job interview with Hina, a seemingly small boy, appears to be dubious already. As Minato meets the owner, things become even more bizarre. Henri Tepes is an ancient vampire, who suddenly falls for him!
synonyms: รักร้ายคุณชายแวมไพร์

title.native: ヴァンパイアは食わず嫌い

106718.description: Note: A live-action AV adaptation (URE-052) was released on November 7th, 2019.

106719.description:
It’s an absolute secret-our relationship! When Nanami finally gets a chance to meet her mom’s new husband and his son, the last person she expects to see is one of her classmates, Kyouhei Suzumura. Not only is her new stepbrother cool and completely unapproachable, but even worse-he’s the crazy-hot guy Nanami’s been crushing on for months…! Only time will tell how Nanami’s unexpectedly forbidden romance will play out…

(Source: Yen Press)

106720.description:
1-10. Swap Slave (スワップスレイブ); Comic Magnum Vol. 78∼87
11. Swap Slave Episode Zero (スワップスレイブ 第零話); Kakioroshi

106721.description: High school girl, Hina, has a routine to shift everything that is of importance to her to an “empty house”. However, one day, she gets spook by a boy who started living there without her knowledge...?!

title.native: カモナ マイハウス

106723.description:
When Hyeri wakes up one day next to a clingy doe-eyed pretty boy that only she can see, keeping her own personal space becomes nigh impossible. Light as a feather and easily frightened, this scaredy cat in a track suit… is her favorite fluffy security blanket?!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Chapter count includes three bonus chapters.
synonyms: My Blanket Turned into a Person!
Bie Zhan Ren! Wo de Bei Zi

106724.description: A small and weak bookworm gets into trouble with a domineering and handsome werewolf! "Anyone who messes with me will be punished!" sneered the werewolf. During what was supposed to be an unexciting game of punishment, unexpectedly, the completely ordinary little bookworm transforms into a handsome and alluring incubus! "You're my type, doggy." the incubus smiled wickedly.

106725.description:
"I'm'ma tell you something. Only TRASH judge people by their looks.... & I'M that trash."

Tooni Himeki, who grew up playing otome games, moves to an island populated by only beautiful men, & every guy she takes an interest in is gay, & she is NOT a fujoshi. But that won't stop her plans to create an all boy harem. & the very first guy she sets her sites on becomes her biggest rival & sort-of friend.

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: The Struggle of a 0 Love Flag Girl
Renai Flag Zero Joshi no Meisou

title.native: 恋愛フラグ0女子の迷走

106726.description: A girl who shut herself in a closet for the last 2 years of middle school realizes she has to go to high school. When she exits her closet for the first time in two years and looks at herself in the mirror, she notices that she grew shimeji mushrooms out of her head.

title.native: シメジ シミュレーション

106727.description:
A tiger and a beaver who grew up together defy peer pressure to end their friendship and join forces to fight injustice. A camel journalist who passed judgment on carnivores for years spends a life-changing night with a seductive wolf. A crocodile and a gazelle must find a way to work together as chef and assistant on a cooking show with flagging ratings. A fox and a chameleon wrestle with stereotypes about each other—and themselves. And much more…

(Source: VIZ Media)

title.native: ビーストコンプレックス

106728.description:
Linlin is a fashion design student, upon touching the tree spirit “Ye”, the two agreed to help each other out. Linlin turned from an ordinary student to the talk of the school due to Ye’s power and her life changed drastically. Ye slowly fell in love with Linlin and with Linlin’s help, Ye finally found his long-dead sister’s body but he must face love, affection, and deception...

(Source: Manga Rock)

106730.description: Kurihara Airi is part of the student council, she's an excellent student and has very good grades, but she's very bad when it comes to love. Behind her facade, there's a controlling girl who doesn't know how to become "cute" until a new neighbor enters in her life as her private tutor. Will he teach her to increase marks in love?
synonyms: 霜月老师的无糖恋爱讲座

title.native: 霜月先生の甘くない恋愛講座

106733.description:
For Lee Jae-Young, room 1305 has been the one constant in his life. He’s lived there since childhood, and it has remained the same even while everything around him has changed. So, you’d think that when his old upstairs neighbor returns, Jae-Young wouldn’t feel any different. In many ways, the tall and confident Lee Tae-Young is nothing like the sweet kid Jae-Young once knew. But, there’s some habits that no amount of time apart can seem to shake. Sure, Tae-Young had always been a little possessive of Jae-Young’s attention, but after what happened…. surely he must have grown out of that by now?! Nevertheless, Tae-Young is certainly no longer the innocent kid that Jae-Young once knew, and now he’s determined to weasel his way back into Jae-Young’s life. From old friendships to hardcore sex, what else will happen in room 1305?

(Source: Lezhin US)

106734.description: Note: A live-action AV adaptation (MIMK-268) was released on February 27th, 2026.

106735.description: Mabuchi Yuniko is the descendant of the Mabuchi family, a family that has long been tasked to destroy the beings from the underworld that seep through certain breaks in reality. These evil beings found that "lockers" can be used to connect their world with ours, giving them a chance to find live bodies to take over. In these lockers, they seek certain items that match their pathos, which can lead them to taking over the owner of the locker. The recent target of these evil beings of the underworld is Watanuki Shizuna, a girl that has a slight fetish for cannibalism. One thing led to another, and now Yuniko and Shizuna make an odd couple tasked to vanquish evil from this world.
synonyms: The story follows the descent world

106736.description: The story of the girls who met at Okinawa's sea. Amane who invites her neighbor living next door Sango to the sea. While bringing about a stormy mood, the two of them also head for the sea today!

106737.description:
Two friends wake up in a strange place. They find themselves in a room with a red cube and no exits. Then, suddenly, there are two more people. Are they friends or foes? Why are they all trapped here? And why does one of the strangers claim the room is alive…?

(Source: Mangamo)

106739.description:
The story centers on the life of Kawata Yoshio, an eccentric judge.

The popularity of the series seems to stem from both the good-natured wisdom of its hero, Judge Kawata, and the glimpse it offers of Japan's judicial system as it deals with current social issues ranging from divorce to substance abuse.

106741.description:
After the death of his mother, Koharu moves in with his step-brother. He was excited by the move, thinking "If I were with my brother again, I might be able to hear the animals' voices like I could back then." This fluffy animal therapy story begins in the town of Hakodate!

(Source: ComicWalker, translated)

Note: Includes 5 extra chapters.

title.native: こはる日和とアニマルボイス

106742.description: Kusuno Kaya is a zoo keeper at Koma Zoo who has the ability to tell the temperature by sight. This manga tells the adventures of Kaya and the other zoo keepers, as they care for many different animals. They do their best to deal with the multitude of problems that arise from caring for these non-domesticated animals.

106743.description: At a house with blooming Japanese Stewartia, the one Natsumi meets is…?

106744.description:
An alchemist who can create gold from nothing is a rare existence—there may be only one in the entire kingdom. Argo, a con artist who uses sleight of hand to impersonate an alchemist, happens to meet the real thing: an alchemist named Nitro. Believing Argo’s tricks to be genuine alchemy, Nitro is overjoyed to find a “fellow alchemist.” But in truth, Nitro has grown weary of life in the castle, forced to produce gold without end, and has run away.

Spending time with Nitro brings back memories for Argo of days spent with his late sister. He lost her because they had no money. “Now you have money—but are you happy?” Nitro’s question shakes him to the core.

What will be born from this encounter—?

106745.description:
"I won't forgive erotic specters!"

Chihiro Tamanoe uses his grandfather's power and clears them up. But he is somehow involved in erotic troubles every time.

title.native: ないしょのハムスター

106749.description: Three single mothers are invited to join the mother son club whose aim is to teach them to find happiness through incest with their sons.
synonyms: The advice of the mother and child
ママたちの汗だく相姦日記〜母子のすすめ『悶』
息子と私の初交尾…見てください〜母子のすすめ「姦」
Mama-tachi no Asedaku Soukan Nikki ~Boshi no Susume "Mon"
Musuko to Watashi no Hatsukoubi… Mitekudasai 〜 Boshi no Susume “Kan”

106752.description: A comic-essay about the events of his family life.

title.native: 家も頑張れお父ちゃん！

106753.description:
"How about a dragon-leather jacket?"

Residing on Magic Kingdom's Royal Warrant street - Dressmaker "Couturiere Shigaraki"
The store's motto is to deliver a "Favourite to wear for a lifetime."

title.native: ヴィーヴル洋裁店～キヌヨとハリエット～

106756.description:
The sequel picks up the plot two years after the end of the battle with Dr. Quaser, and a think tank named At Random is attempting to apply robots to daily use for the public. The setting is in Singapore. The new story focuses on three characters: Lantse, a successor unit to Pulse; Maria Maria, a girl who is depressed after she suffers from an accident; and Shiruto, a boy who wants to become a robot. A 13-year-old Nobuhiko, a 19-year-old Chris, and Signal will also appear in the story.

(Source: Anime News Network)

106757.description:
In a world of swords and sorcery, a ritual summons the “sorcerer king” who will bring ruin—but all it coughs up is an ordinary boy from Earth. Stripped of his memories but endowed with unbelievable power, our protagonist isn’t keen on destroying the world. Fortunately, tinkering with his newfound power results in the creation of an intimidating partner to keep him safe!

(source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Hametsu no Madouou to Golem no Banhi

title.english: The Sorcerer King of Destruction and the Golem of the Barbarian Queen
title.native: 破滅の魔導王とゴーレムの蛮妃
title.romaji: Hametsu no Madou Ou to Golem no Ban Kisaki

106758.description:
One big fat lie and a few twisted truths.

Even in his past life, Cid's dream wasn't to become a protagonist or a final boss. He'd rather lie low as a minor character until it's prime time to reveal he's a mastermind...or at least, do the next best thing-pretend to be one! And now that he's been reborn into another world, he's ready to set the perfect conditions to live out his dreams to the fullest. Armed with his overactive imagination, Cid jokingly recruits members to his organization and makes up a whole backstory about an evil cult that they need to take down. Well, as luck would have it, these imaginary adversaries turn out to be the real deal-and everyone knows the truth but him!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: To Be a Power in the Shadows!
ชีวิตไม่ต้องเด่น ขอแค่เป็นเทพในเงา

title.native: 陰の実力者になりたくて！

106759.description:
He has no name, and he has no memory. All he knows is that he was summoned by a dark spell with a gruesome sacrifice. Now, he’s the Sorcerer King of Destruction, fated to bring about the end of the world. His only hope to defy that fate lies in his partner, a beautiful elven golem with a terrifying taste for violence. She will be his greatest protector—just as he must become hers!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: The Sorcerer King of Destruction and the Golem of the Barbarian Queen

title.english: The Sorcerer King of Destruction and the Golem of the Barbarian Queen
title.native: 破滅の魔導王とゴーレムの蛮妃
title.romaji: Hametsu no Madou Ou to Golem no Ban Kisaki

106760.description:
The protagonist who was rarely ever at school during his middle school and high school days, is unemployed even as an adult. From morning till night, it was video games. For him who was ranked first worldwide, it was his life.

One day, his character is suddenly hacked. The data was unrecoverable and there was nothing that could be done. Feeling great despair at having lost his rank that he had bet everything to achieve in a world that controlled his life, the protagonist attempts suicide.

When he awakens, he finds himself inside the video game, no, it was a real world that resembled it. There, he notices that he has reincarnated into the the body of a sub character that he had created and bought premium benefits for long ago but had left neglected.
synonyms: Moto Sekai Ichi'i Subchara Ikusei Nikki: Hai Player, Isekai wo Kouryakuchuu!
The Former Top 1's Sub-Character Training Diary: A Dedicated Player is Currently Conquering Another World!~
The Former World Number 1's Alt Character Training Diary

title.native: 元・世界1位のサブキャラ育成日記 ～廃プレイヤー、異世界を攻略中！～
title.romaji: Moto Sekai 1-i no Sub Chara Ikusei Nikki: Hai Player, Isekai wo Kouryaku-chuu!

106761.description:
He never performed well in either middle nor high school, and even after becoming an adult, he never worked. Be it morning, noon or night, he only played an online game. For him, being the world’s number one rank, playing that online game, was his very reason for living.

One day, his account was hacked and his character deleted. Restoration was impossible. Nothing that could be done. The number 1 rank that he literally spent his life to attain and to defend was now lost. Filled with despair, he turned to suicide.

When he opened his eyes again, there was the online game. No, the world itself looked similar to the game. He had been reborn as the extra character of the premium avatar he created in the past, but left untouched.

The former world’s top, was reborn in a world that looked like that online game. That was the beginning of his extraordinary legend.

A knight, a cat, a dark elf, and so on. Together with several unique companions, his training to regain his “world’s first rank” now begins

title.native: 元・世界1位のサブキャラ育成日記 ～廃プレイヤー、異世界を攻略中！～
title.romaji: Moto Sekai 1-i no Sub Chara Ikusei Nikki: Hai Player, Isekai wo Kouryaku-chuu!

106762.description:
The manga's story is an homage to Edogawa Rampo's fictional character Akechi Kogorou. The mystery centers around Mayumi Hanazaki, a middle-school girl who used to live with her aunt and uncle until a mysterious person mercilessly killed both. Now, thanks to an unusual incident, Mayumi relies upon the spirit of the legendary detective Kogorou Akechi to solve case.

(Source: Anime News Network)

106763.description: Manga adaptation of the second series of Kemono Friends.

106765.description:
The time is a fantastical near-future. The place: the dangerous industrial city of Chester Valley. Rachel, a willful daughter of a zaibatsu family asks a pair of androids to help her... A new tale of a retro-future sci-fi world by Saraike Atsushi.

Included chapter: 0

title.native: レイチェル・ダイアル

106767.description:
Dias finally returns home after decades of war. He's hailed as a hero and promptly rewarded with his own domain...which turns out to be little more than empty plains. Population: zero. Dias, who has only ever known battle, finds himself at a loss. How is he supposed to survive, let alone cultivate his territory into a thriving, prosperous dominion when there's nothing but grass as far as can see?

Fortunately for Dias, a horned girl by the name of Alna is about to show him there's more to the plains than meets the eye!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: Ryomin Zeronin Sutaato no Henkyou Ryoushu-sama
The Population Of The Frontier Owner Starts With 0. "Dias The Blue" And A Blue Horned Girl.
Lãnh chúa vùng đất không cư dân

title.english: The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects
title.native: 領民0人スタートの辺境領主様

106768.description:
The apprentice hunter who hates being the target of attention, Eil of the village Albat.
Upon becoming 15, at the Ceremony of Determination that he needs to go through to be acknowledged as an adult, he is determined to possess the ‘Talent for Megane.’
Megane?
What does that even mean?
But gradually, Eil discovers the countless possibilities hidden within his megane, one at a time.
“I think these glasses might actually enable me to conquer the whole world. Not that I’m going to do it, though.”
Thus begins the bizarre megane life of Eil, the megane young man.
synonyms: My Glasses Will Be Able to Conquer the Whole World, I Suppose.

title.native: 俺のメガネはたぶん世界征服できると思う。
title.romaji: Ore no Megane wa Tabun Sekai Seifuku Dekiru To Omou.

106769.description:
On the day of selection， a boy named Eile discovers that he has the gift to create glasses. Wasting no time， he puts on a pair and sets off for the royal capital where his older sister， Holn， lives. However， he soon discovers that these glasses possess an astonishing power. “Could this be the key to ruling the world?” He wonders.
And so begins the strange and outrageous adventure of a boy with mysterious glasses and his almighty -if a bit scatterbrained - sister!

(Source: Manga Mirai)
synonyms: My Glasses Will Be Able to Conquer the Whole World, I Suppose.

title.english: My Glasses Will Be Able to Conquer the Whole World, I Suppose. Eile's Strange Life with his Glasses
title.native: 俺のメガネはたぶん世界征服できると思う。
title.romaji: Ore no Megane wa Tabun Sekai Seifuku Dekiru To Omou.

106770.description:
After decades of war, Dias returns home as a hero and is rewarded with his own domain. When he arrives at his new lands, however, they turn out to be little more than endless grassy plains without even a single subject. Literally put out to pasture, Dias is stumped as to how to live any life other than a soldier's. But when a horned girl named Alna crosses his path, Dias takes his first steps to being the lord of a not-so-empty frontier.

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: Ryomin Zeronin Sutaato no Henkyou Ryoushu-sama
The Population Of The Frontier Owner Starts With 0. "Dias The Blue" And A Blue Horned Girl.

title.english: The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects: Tales of Blue Dias and the Onikin Alna
title.native: 領民0人スタートの辺境領主様
かげひなたに恥じらいを！

106773.description:
The story is set 20 years after Hoshi no Hitomi no Silhouette. The story follows Yuzuki Setogawa, a new college student who meets an attractive man on the day of her entrance ceremony.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 星屑セレナーデ 星の瞳のシルエット another story
title.romaji: Hoshikuzu Serenade: Hoshi no Hitomi no Silhouette Another Story

106774.description:
Kuroda is a homicide investigator who was locked inside a house with his dead family for days as a child. The trauma left him with the ability to pick up the scent of a dead body quicker than anyone else could. Kuroda is assigned to the "Special Search & Investigations Office," aka the "S&I Office," a new team created within the MPD to investigate unique missing persons cases, where he meets a brilliant criminal profiler named Ikaga... The man who can find dead bodies the quickest, and the man who can arrive at the perp the quickest. The living and the dead meet in this police suspense story!

(Source: MangaHot)

106775.description:
The last in a long line of Witches of the Black Wood, Marie Blackwood lives a quiet life in Edinburgh – away from the scrutiny of the Church. But when the Church thrusts 13-year-old Theo into her hands for safekeeping, Marie suddenly gains the responsibility not just of taking care of a teenager – but protecting the world, and Theo himself, from the amazing power that lives inside of him.

(Source: Titan Manga)
synonyms: La Sorcière du château aux chardons
La Bruja del Castillo de los Cardos
La Bruixa del Castell dels Cards

106777.description:
Sword Magic, where a sword is manipulated using magic to freely fly in the air, cutting down enemies. Ardis is a user of this new magic art that has never been seen before throughout the entirety of the history of magic. As a mercenary, he undertakes various requests in return for remuneration, including subjugations, escorts and investigations.

On the way home from a survey request, he protects a pair of twin girls who survived their caravan being attacked by bandits, however in this world twins are considered “abominations”.

Along with the twins and a girl who accompanies him as a follower, he holds back his anger at the world which looks coldly at the twin girls due to the goddess’ intervention.

This is the story of such a swordsman called the countless swords sorcerer.
synonyms: The Swordsman Called The Countless Swords' Sorcerer
The Swordsman Called the Countless Swords Sorcerer
ผู้กล้ามนตรากับวิชาดาบพันเล่ม

title.english: The Swordsman Dubbed the Sorcerer of Countless Swords
title.native: 千剣の魔術師と呼ばれた剣士
title.romaji: Senken no Majutsushi to Yobareta Kenshi

106779.description:
A little bit of magic, a little bit of mystery, and a whole lot of comfort food.

An aristocratic lady who can’t eat her own cooking, a young man set adrift in life, and a boy of mysterious origin: three people brought together by fate. Lisa’s greatest wish is to cook a delicious meal for her guests, but not only are her culinary skills questionable, her motivations lie elsewhere. Meanwhile, two ‘lost boys’ find their way to her estate, and gradually discover something they did not realise they were looking for.

(Source: Shogakukan Asia)
synonyms: 麗莎難以入口的餐桌料理

title.native: リサの食べられない食卓

106780.description:
A 4-koma spin-off based on the #compass battle game.
Various artists contribute to the comic each week.

title.native: #コンパス 共同生活解析システム

106781.description:
A wacky-loser comedy about Lord Belial, one of the Four Heavenly Generals.

Includes 4 bonus chapters.
synonyms: Belial-sama is one of the Four Heavenly General, but she's xx

title.native: ベリアル様は四天王の中でも××
title.romaji: Belial-sama wa Shitennou no Naka demo xx

106782.description:
Past the dreams there is a special world, where monsters and demons fight for supremacy, it so happens those same monsters and demons are also the objects of cult for religions in the real world. A victory in the monster world, means the success of a religion in the real world.
Wahowaho is a new religion, aiming to the top, and while searching for their god they have summoned a clueless human boy.

Toda Yuu was visiting a fan convention with his sister, he was looking forward the event for his favourite game, a phone gacha game with deities, but once he fell asleep things started to change in the real world.
synonyms: Welcome to Religion in Another World

title.native: 異世界宗教へようこそ！

106783.description:
The "otaku girls" role-playing game takes place "a little bit in the future in 20XX." Akihabara, which was once called "the otaku holy land," is now in decline after otaku culture itself has declined. Players take on the role of a manager of one of the few remaining "otaku shops." The manager helps to "raise" various talented otaku girls, and together, players and the girls battle a "virus" that is infecting the world of various works, while also retrieving people's lost "memories."

(Source: Anime News Network)

106784.description: A oneshot about a fifteen-year-old high school girl who still looks like she's six. The other girls in class therefore treat her like a little kid.
synonyms: The Girl Who Will Grow Up to be a Beauty

title.native: 大人になったら美人になる子ちゃん
title.romaji: Otona ni Nattara Bijin ni Naru Ko-chan

106785.description:
With BL manga as her greatest and only love, Aizawa is destined to be forever alone. All her time not spent in the office is spent fawning over fanart of her favorite pairing, completely wasting her beauty. One day, the goddess of her world, the artist Misumi, announces that she will descend on a comic convention, so off Aizawa goes! When she finds Misumi's booth, what awaits her is...a super cute high school girl?!

(Source: INKR)

title.romaji: Kami Eshi JK to OL Fujoshi

title.native: メイちゃんは焼肉が恋しい

106788.description:
Sakura Nakajima, Mao Sasaki, and Rina Yoshizawa are three troubled teen girls, who happen to frequent the same rock cafe. They are brought together by the owner to form a band.

Note: JK☆Rock is a prequel story to the 2019 film of the same title.

106789.description:
Scatterbrained Takara Takarada is an undiscovered genius actor who fully embodies every character he's cast as, delivering unforgettable performance after performance onstage. But this genius can only be brought forth by his best friend and fellow actor, Yuujin Kamoshima, who cares for Takara even as he envies him for his innate talent.

When it takes the two of them together to bring a character to life, what will happen when Takara is scouted away from their small-time theater troupe and thrust into the new world of television instead? Can Takara survive without Yuujin's guidance... and how does Yuujin respond to being left behind?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Notes:
- Won an Excellence Award from the 23rd Japan Media Arts Festival.
- Seventeenth place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

106790.description: Nisekoi Bangai-hen: Ticket is a special one-shot released to commemorate the theatrical opening of the live-action Nisekoi film.

title.native: ニセコイ番外編 チケット

106791.description: The February issue of Tokuma Shoten's Animage magazine will start a novel adaptation for the series. The novel will serve as both a prequel and a spinoff to the upcoming anime Kochoki: Wakaki Nobunaga.

synonyms: It's Hard to Marry a Vampire

106793.description: Ootani Rin, a girl from a poor family due to her father's gambling is attending a highschool on a scholarship. She has been taking care of her sisters and mother ever since her father ran away. Her school doesn't allow its students to work part time but she's not worried about it since all the students at her school are rich. However one boy takes interest in her, finds out about her part-time job and to keep him quiet she has to make him a bentou (packed lunch).

106794.description:
Based on the hit manga, light novel, and anime series by Nakatani Nio. Experience the world of this beloved yuri romance through the perspectives of other creators!

More tales of budding relationships featuring Yuu, Touko, Sayaka, and all your other faves! Maid outfits, kisses stolen during student council meetings, Touko cross-dressing, and bathtime with Riko and Miyako—all that and more can be found in this collection of stories about girls blooming into love…with each other!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

106796.description:
Izumi Madono is a newly hired zookeeper, the job of her dreams. However, the realities of her new workplace are wilder than her imagination...?! A touching story about the bond between people and animals at a zoo! Supervision by Etsuo Narushima.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: みんなの動物園 ～いづみの飼育係日誌～
title.romaji: Minna no Doubutsuen: Izumi no Shiikugakari Nisshi

106797.description: A story about the path to maturity, and how that affects two friends. Gakky and Utsumin are always together. What happens when one friend wants to grow up faster than the other?

106799.description:
Wakano, who likes to make things, entered Hijikan Industrial High School. "I am lucky and warm at high school life where young people live with many friends around mainly making things I like".

(Source: Amazon JP, translated)

106800.description: High school teacher Ueda Yuusuke finds out his crossdressing photos from his past are still shared on social media. On top of that, the person behind the account using his photos suddenly gets closer to his student, Kosaka. How much can Ueda get involved into his students' relathionships? Despite his worries, he decides to do something about that mysterious account...

106802.description: This collection of short stories features girls in imaginative situations. For instance, one story follows a woman as she tries to balance her responsibilities as a magic girl and a mother. In another, ninja girls are hired to work as Santa Clauses.

106803.description: Side story of the manga Main Dish.

synonyms: 7時の夕食-えのもと椿短編集

106805.description:
After falling into the gap between worlds, I gained “the ability to identify something’s status” for the cost of a single limitation. However, other than this skill I was completely ordinary. All I could do after landing in a strange world, was see through the status of things and use that information for my own growth.

One day, after being assaulted by enemies, a lone figure appeared and saved my life. What’s more, that person had an incredible “secret”.
synonyms: 美女与贤者与魔人之剑
Beauty, Sage and the Devil's Sword

106807.description: Asahi Rintarou is a 2nd year high school boy who called out his senpai Shiori to a park in order to confess his love. As he readies to convey his feelings he realizes that they are not alone in the park and that someone was right behind them the whole time.
synonyms: ライバルは君のうしろに

title.romaji: Rival wa Kimi no Ushiro ni

106808.description: In the depths of a demonic castle filled with monsters, a young hero meets a boy gifted by the supernatural. With a common goal but wildly different motivations, the most unlikely pair sets out on a quest to defeat the Dark Lord!
synonyms: Yuusha no Musume to Ryokushoku no Mahoutsukai
The Hero Girl and the Green Magician

title.native: 勇者の娘と緑色の魔法使い
title.romaji: Yuusha no Musume to Midoriiro no Mahoutsukai

106810.description:
An accident designed by her ex-boyfriend changed her life dramatically and her father's being put in prison make her to find someone powerful to help. And price she offers is herself. What she doesn't know is, that cold and bossy man she sells herself for falls in love with her at first sight. Once a young rich lady, nowadas a puppet, she tries to flee and he tries his best to make her stay. As the wheel of fortune started, where will they go.
(Source: Webcomics)

title.native: 蜜桃小情人之烈爱知夏
title.romaji: Mi Tao Xiao Qingren Zhi Lie Ai Zhixia

106811.description:
For ten years, Beatriz has been in bitter love with Travis. She has been trapped in the taste of his gentleness. But every answer to the implicit confession of her love is the coolest rejection. Finally, when she makes up her mind to let it go, Travis suddenly finds his life is so pale and boring without her and she has taken up the most important part of his life. Screwing up courage, Travis decides to make the final response: he wants to love and take great care of her.

(Source: Webcomics)
synonyms: Bác Sĩ Sở Cũng Muốn Yêu
อ้อนรักคุณหมอฉู่
楚先生でも恋がしたい

title.romaji: Chu Yisheng Ye Yao Tan Lianai

106812.description:
In order to help out her best friend, Yasmin Lin pretended to be the mistress in a relationship and went head-to-head with the legal wife. Unfortunately, she mistakenly smashed Ji Group's president Laurence Ji's luxury car. In exchange, Yasmin is forced to become Laurence's fiancée in revenge against his father...

(Source: Webcomics)

106813.description:
I, a self-proclaimed and widely acknowledged ugly girl, was somehow confessed to by the popular guy in class, Kitami-kun! I thought he’d get bored quickly, so I said yes, but he shows no signs of losing interest! What's up with this guy?!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

Includes 3 bonus chapters.
synonyms: A Face Unsuitable For This World.

title.english: My Face Doesn’t Belong in This World
title.native: 顔がこの世に向いてない。

106814.description: A light-hearted comedy about the lives of a grandfather and his granddaughter - serialisation of the original twitter publication.

106815.description:
Amano and Chloe Mashiro are twin sisters who live in the Hakubu Zoo in the sleepy town of Hakubucho. They thought the zoo was a peaceful, quiet place, until one day they suddenly gained the ability to talk to the animals. They found out that there are many animals with troubles of their own, and they formed an "Animal Counseling Section" to help! The two sisters will present heartwarming animal stories!

(Source: Ribon Comics, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.native: ぼくらはみんな シロとクロの動物お悩み相談係
title.romaji: Bokura wa Minna Shiro to Kuro no Doubutsu Onayami Soudan Kakari

106816.description:
If it’s from you, even pain is a lovely gift.

Vampires, supernatural beings that live off the opposite sex’s blood. Chiyu, is an innocent girl who’s yet to learn about love. At first, she didn’t like Yomiya, the vampire in her class because he was a playboy but, she finds him collapsed from anemia…! With no other option, Chiyu lets Yomiya suck her blood which he finds delicious, leading him to say he’ll make her fall in love with him. Apparently, “the blood of a maiden in love” is like nothing else…?

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

Notes:
- Includes ten extra chapters.
- Includes the one-shot "Oboreru Ningyo-hime (溺れる人魚姫)"
- Includes the one-shot "Akaringo no Kyuuketsu-hime (赤林檎の吸血姫)"
- Includes the one-shot "Goshujin-sama ni Gohoubi (ご主人様にごほうび)"
- Includes the one-shot "Koishite Inoreba (恋して祈れば)".

To continue living, I have to continue making dungeons.

Subsequently, she and her family decided to move to a small town an hour's drive from the city, where Hiro decides to open a cafe. As for Touko, she must now learn how to reconnect with her daughter, Hana, after her busy work life resulted in them growing distant from one another. This will be no easy task. Manabu loses the chance to be with his crush Mizuho who now has a thing for Rui & gets nose bleeds from her cuteness. The teacher is of no help, her focus & nose bleeds are on Rui's hot cousin who is also an alien!

The new 2nd year student council body also plays a role in the story.The student president Hikaru is short & hot tempered, he is dating the vice president Nozomi who is tall & gorgeous. The treasurer Kazuma is a good looking guy with a great voice, yet he wears a mask and is madly in love with the cute guy secretary named Touru (who is unsure of Kazuma and his feelings)!

There is another side story BL with Kazuma and Touru - Kazuma is slowly wearing Touru down with his love!

Shy and introverted, Tadokoro Kageko passes her free time in class drawing instead of hanging out with her classmates. But even when her classmates approach her, it’s only to make fun of her drawings and appearance. In stark contrast, Nikaidou Sakurako is well-liked among her peers as she has both beauty and smarts. And while everyone makes fun of Tadokoro, Nikaidou on the other hand, is totally infatuated with her. Just one look at one of Tadokoro’s drawings and Nikaidou fell in love with the art and eventually, the artist herself. When Tadokoro offers to draw Nikaidou a portrait, Nikaidou becomes ecstatic as this may be her chance to get closer with the girl she has been obsessing over.

もっとマンガで分かる！Fate/Grand Order
Even More Learning with Manga! Fate/Grand Order
ますますマンガで分かる！Fate/Grand Order

106917.description: A guy gains a younger step-brother named Aoi after his mom remarries, only to discover later that Aoi enjoys cross-dressing.

title.native: 葵くんは死にたがりの女の子(♂)

106922.description: Ayano-san is a beautiful housewife with a son, Yuusei, who doesn't seem to approve of her carefree ways. Always smiling and well-meaning, Ayano-san still finds a way to make herself an object of curiosity and appreciation by passing people.

title.romaji: 0.2 Lux no Mahou no Shita de

106928.description:
Momoko, a first-year high school student, has been extremely reserved ever since elementary school. Her best friend Mahiru, who always supported her, passed away just before they were to enter middle school. Then Momoko falls in love for the first time, but struggles to move forward. Suddenly, Mahiru appears before her, dressed in the school uniform she was never able to wear, claiming that she is a ghost.

Love and friendship intertwine in this sweet yet bitter story of first loves.

(Source: MANGA MILLION)
synonyms: Ein Liebesbrief, den du mir nie geschrieben hast

106929.description:
Ji-U is a kind-hearted young man who harnesses the lightning quick reflexes of a cat to secretly make the world a better place – one saved little child or foster pet at a time. Kayden is a secret agent on the run, who finds himself stuck in the body of a…um…decidedly fat old fluffy cat. Together, armed with Ji-U’s super powers and Kayden’s uber-smarts, they’re out to fight those forces who would let evil rule this world. That is, if they can stand each other long enough to get the job done.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

106933.description:
After the battle against the raid boss and receiving an attack from the dark elves, a familiar figure appears before Kirito after: the dark elf swordsman from Sword Art Online, Kizmel! Kirito is also in an event area that should be devoted to rescuing the captured Silica and Premiere, but danger approaches the dark elves in the form of an evil demon...

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Sword Art Online: Hollow Realization is an adaptation of the console game of the same title.

title.native: ソードアート・オンライン ホロウ・リアリゼーション

106936.description: A pet essay about a "Strong" and "Ferocious" falcon that in reality doesn't do much else but sleep.

title.native: だらけハヤブサとだらだら生活

106937.description: The story of a drunk girl that can grant wishes, or can she?

106938.description:
Kento Kanzaki, Akira Toumoto, and Souta Segawa—high school classmates—all have older sisters. Kento’s sister, Miki, is a tyrant; Akira’s sister, Akane, is childish; and Souta’s sister, Shiori, is overprotective. With such different types of older sisters, the three have been at their mercy since childhood. On top of that, since they attend the same high school, they never get a moment’s peace. Although they try to find a way to turn the tables, the fear of their sisters—instilled in them since childhood—simply won’t go away… Now is the time to stand up, little brothers! A sibling comedy woven around three pairs of siblings!

Note: chapter count Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: うちの姉ちゃんときたら！

106940.description:
Become a traitor.

Kijima Heihachiro is a masked second-hand bookshop owner who sorts out things that "should not exist" in the official history.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

106941.description:
Jun Ichijou is a high school student. However, he is a loner and even on lunch break the only thing he does is studying. As a result of great effort, his test ranking rose and while he was satisfied with his loner life,

"Hi-hi-hi... Virgin, teach me again♪"

"Shut up, b*tch. Let's finish it quick today, okay?"

"Yay!"

One day, it was decided that he will help blonde gal Karen Tachibana, central figure of the class, with her studies. Loner during lunch break, tête-à-tête studying after school... So continues the double life. Tsundere-like, but good at taking care of people Ichijou-kun. A bit mischievous Tachibana-san with an innocent smile. With this and that happening, the two get along so well that others cringe.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)
synonyms: Lonely Loser, I’ll Become Blonde Frivolous Gyaru’s Favourite

title.native: 青春敗者ぼっち野郎、金髪尻軽ギャルのお気に入りになる
title.romaji: Seishun Haishabocchi Yarou, Kinpatsu Shirigaru Gal no Okiniiri ni Naru

title.native: 何故か学校一の美少女が休み時間の度に、ぼっちの俺に話しかけてくるんだが？
title.romaji: Naze ka Gakkou Ichi no Bishoujo ga Yasumi Jikan no Tabi ni, Bocchi no Ore ni Hanashikakete Kurunda ga?

106944.description:
Teenager Shiinya Kazuya died while saving young girls from an attacker, only to find himself reincarnated into a world of swords and magic. It was a dream come true! Though he remembers his life and knowledge of Earth, he is now Cain von Silford, the third son of an aristocrat. Being granted the protection of the gods on his fifth birthday turned out to be too much of a good thing for Cain. His stats and boosts are so powerful, he must hide his real abilities to climb the ranks of society as he descends into the darkest dungeons. The ultimate isekai adventure begins as a teen-turned-child is trapped in a beautiful kingdom he didn’t create, but might one day rule!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Chronicles of an Aristocrat Reborn in Another World

title.english: Chronicles of an Aristocrat Reborn in Another World
title.native: 転生貴族の異世界冒険録　～自重を知らない神々の使徒～
title.romaji: Tensei Kizoku no Isekai Boukenroku: Jichou wo Shiranai Kamigami no Shito

title.native: 幼なじみが僕のちん○狙ってる。
title.romaji: Osananajimi ga Boku no Chinpo Neratteru.

106946.description:
Tsugami Kazaya is an experienced swordsman who travels to another world and back again on a daily basis while also attending high school! After a certain incident, he ended up instructing a senior student from his high school, the beautiful Mikoto Chihiro, on the basics of adventuring! After that, Chihiro, who was usually cool and difficult to approach, started to show her true bright personality only to Kazaya!?

“I did it! I did it, Tsugami-kun! I was able to slay it!”

“S-Senpai, don’t you think your personality has changed a little too much!?”

The Earth and the other world, a RomCom and an adventure story, the two of them travel constantly between the two!! It’s the start of a new twist on a fantasy after school!!

title.native: 異世界クエストは放課後に！

106947.description:
He approached and trapped her with a devastating smell, raping her every night. She fought back with her words,

"Do you believe I will neutralize you?"

He sneered calmly,

"I will sleep you even if I was neutralized. What I want is, from beginning to end, to push you down throughout my life."

(Source: MangaToon)
synonyms: The Demonic CEO In My Bed

106948.description:
As a talented agent, she failed to make a successful time-travel during her first task in which she dropped onto the bed of a tyrant and broke his sex. Knocked out, she regarded the man as a man-whore and paid him for their sex. Obviously she went too far. However, tyrants are for torturing, money for spending kungfu for teasing and beauty for seduction.

(Source: MangaToon)
synonyms: Refuse Spoiling From The Despot: Hot Princess
Refusing the Tyrant’s Favor: The Fierce Princess
Vương Phi Hung Mãnh: Từ Chối Bạo Quân Chuyên Sủng

title.native: 拒绝暴君专宠：凶猛王妃
title.romaji: Jujue Baojun Zhuan Chong: Xiongmeng Wangfei

106949.description:
It's a story about snatching and bully. Her aunt brought a daughter to seek shelter in her family, but it turned out her cousin sister shared the same father with her and even snatched her lover. It's a story about rebirth and revenge. After rebirth with her previous memory, she intended to take revenge on every one who hurt her in the last life.

(Source: MangaToon)

Note: Includes 8 extra chapters

title.native: 六識転想アタラクシア

106952.description: A young woman deals with both parental rejection and her growing feelings for her new roommate.

106953.description: A young woman in an unfulfilling relationship fantasizes about the woman she has fallen in love with.

106954.description: Oomugi Wakaba inherits a mansion from her late great-grandmother, an expert pen artist. Within a hidden room, she meets the mysterious blue-eyed girl wrapped in crimson chains, Red Riding Hood. Together with the strongest beast, she comes to learn about the world of magic, witches and grimoires.
synonyms: จอมเวทย์สมุดมนตรา

106955.description: When she wandered the border of life and death at the age of three, Cordelia realized that she had been reincarnated into a game she had used to play as a high handed noble girl. A dark future would await her if she fell in love with the Prince. Therefore, for the sake of a normal life, there was no road but to avoid the powerful prince and the heroine…… But just doing that would be boring. She finally was blessed with a beautiful appearance so she resolved to polish herself, firstly by beginning to study herbology…… This is that kind of story.
synonyms: 水果糖香味的千金物语
Drop!! ~A Tale of the Fragrance Princess~
Drop!!: A Tale of the Fragrance Princess

title.native: ドロップ!! ～香りの令嬢物語～

106956.description: When she wandered the border of life and death at the age of three, Cordelia realized that she had been reincarnated into a game she had used to play as a high handed noble girl. A dark future would await her if she fell in love with the Prince. Therefore, for the sake of a normal life, there was no road but to avoid the powerful prince and the heroine…… But just doing that would be boring. She finally was blessed with a beautiful appearance so she resolved to polish herself, firstly by beginning to study herbology…… This is that kind of story.

Drop!!: A Tale of the Fragrance Princess

106957.description:
Yomi Kawanaka ,A new employee of 'Always Death games' is just doing her job, kidnapping people and let them play her deadly survival games that is until a spoiled rich kid named Shuichi Yatsubishi always wins her games using his skill and money.

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.
synonyms: Please Look Forward to the Next Death Game!!

title.native: 次回のデスゲームにご期待ください!!
title.romaji: Jikai no Death Game ni Gokitai Kudasai!!

106961.description:
After that day, she stopped being a girl.

In the wake of an assault, Nina Kamiyama, a former idol in the group Pure Club, shuns her femininity and starts dressing as a boy. At high school she keeps to herself, but fellow student Hikaru Horiuchi realizes who she is. What secrets is she keeping? The shocking drama starts.

(Source: VIZ Media)

Notes: Nominated to the 23rd Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize.

title.native: さよならミニスカート

106962.description: A sweet and short oneshot perfect for the holidays.

106963.description: Fang Zheng, the head of the Ministry of Justice in the Da Xi Dynasty abhorred evil, a stance that antagonised many against him. Surrounded and attacked from all sides by his enemies, Fang Zheng died on Cang Luan mountain. But his soul would resurrect in a weak child, along with the memories of his past life, his passionate desire for justice, and his belief in punishing evil with evil. Fang Zheng will strike down those in his path without mercy until he becomes the most revered and respected on both heaven and earth.

106964.description: The manga centers on Kamo and his partner Tora, who work in the underworld as "avengers for hire," taking on jobs from the victims of violent crimes and families seeking vengeance for wrongs done to them.
synonyms: The Scum of Good and Evil

106965.description:
Niinuma, a young man who has a tendency to live in his own fantasy world, fell in love with Obata, an elite at their company. The first night he spent with the gentle and sweet Obata, Niinuma could see a different side of him.

"It's too late. You're the one who seduced me."

He was confused, but surrendered himself to the extremely intense love affair. But one day, he heard a rumor about Obata. Which side of the prince by day, beast by night is the real him?

title.native: ホワイトヌーン、ブラックナイト

106966.description:
Series of unusual, strange, and mysterious thriller.

(Source: WEBTOON)

106968.description:
Become a wealthy, mysterious, man’s wife or let your ill father die? Macie Qiao must decide. The contract stipulates two years as President Xiao’s wife. In return, he will pay for any all medical bills. He’s handsome. He’s rich. The question remains: what are his true motives and why Macie?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: All's Fair in Love and War

106969.description:
Was it a dream? Young, brilliant Ivy wakes up in her family’s home after weeks in ancient Egypt, transported there by a magical bracelet. She can still see him—Bifitu, the charismatic prince, who became one of Egypt's greatest Pharaohs. And she was Nefertari, whom history would record as his beloved queen. But something had changed. Bifitu is now all but forgotten, the archives noting he had died just two years into his reign. She has to return, to set things right... even if it means her life.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Sand and Song of the Seas

106970.description:
On Beloved ex's wedding, ex's brother falls in love with her at first sight... "Fate is such a naughty boy" she said, "Why couldn't I deserve a normal romance?"

(Source: WebComics)

106971.description:
Do you know about the saying, "Beautiful shoes bring happiness to the person who wears them?"

Note: Published in Canna Vol. 23.

106972.description: Enter Minase Hiroto, the hero - or rather, Blue Knight - of the action TV series “Knights of the Holy War: Grand Knights”. And he’s feeling blue, alright. He just wants to get to know his stuntman, Imagi Takafumi, better, but all his attempts to invite him out for drinks have been declined without fail. One day, Minase spots Imagi out on the streets and runs after him - and into a gay bar?!

106973.description:
A dramatic, hilarious and timid girl caught the eye of a grim looking man. She keeps her cool despite being frightened. On the other hand, this man actually has a completely different side of him! Let's witness as this hilarious love story unfolds between two distinctly different characters.

(Source: Webcomics)

106974.description:
A collection of Takeshima Eku's short yuri stories.

1. Kimi ni Suki tte Iwasetai (君に好きっていわせたい)
Kei and Misaki have been best friends since they were kids. One day, Misaki confesses her feelings for Kei and the two of them start going out. To Kei, everything seems to be going alright but to Misaki...

2. Kimi ga Suki tte Ittekita (君が好きっていってきた)
Continuation of Kimi ga Suki tte Ittekita.

3. Uchi no Neko ga Kawaii Youjo ni Naru Nante! (ウチの猫が可愛い幼女になるなんてっ！)

4. Super Maid ni Omakase Kudasai! (スーパーメイドにお任せください!)
Kuro's mistress makes an impossible request to her.

5. NEET Na Oneesan Hiroimashita. (ニートなお姉さん拾いました。)
An office lady encounters a homeless girl on the street and reluctantly lets her stay at her place.

6. Miyuri no Shiro-chan (みゆりのしろちゃん)
Miyuri has made a snowman every winter. One year she puts her special scarf the one she made. A few days later, Shiro arrives at her door, wearing her scarf.

7. Hen Ai (へんあい)
synonyms: I Want You to Say You Love Me
Uchi no Neko ga Kawaii Youjo ni Naru Nante!

title.native: 君に好きっていわせたい

106975.description: The author, Michi Tarasawa, tells of her life with her two cats, Biki and Maru, that were given to her by her mentor, Yumiko Ooshima.

title.native: ビキまるだって猫である
title.romaji: Biki Maru Datte Neko de Aru

106976.description:
Rika likes to drink. She goes to this bar to find a "man with a wrist watch" who once comforted her when she got drunk. But the only man who talks to her at the bar is Masa, who's an unshaven older man... One night, Rika finds herself in a strange place after she passed out, and sees the man she was looking for kissing her and caressing her body... But when she wakes up, the man next to her was not whom she expected!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Originally serialized under the title "Ero Shinshi no Gokujou Tech - Sono Seikantai, Ore ga Sodatete Ageru" (エロ紳士の極上テク～その性感帯、オレが育ててあげる).

エロ紳士の極上テク～その性感帯、オレが育ててあげる

title.english: Sexy Gentleman's Superb Techniques -I'll Teach You How to be Sexy-
title.native: たくさん気持ちよくしてあげる

106977.description: A young man experiences his first heartbreak.

title.native: 松のトゲ, 恋のトゲ
title.romaji: Matsu no Toge, Koi no Toge

synonyms: A Straight Girl Wanders Into a Lesbian Mixer
Les Goukon to Mayoikonda Nonke no Musume

title.native: レズ合コンと迷い込んだノンケの娘
title.romaji: Rezu Goukon to Mayoikonda Nonke no Musume

title.native: 女騎士さまは屈しない

106983.description:
"Inoue-san, you're my first boyfriend...", says Yamamoto, 28 years old. "I don't have a lot of experience either, but we'll work through it together", says Inoue, 32 years old. In reality, Inoue's never been with a girl either, but he couldn't tell Yamamoto that. A fluffy love-comedy about the adventures of this innocent and pure couple.

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.
synonyms: I'm nearly 30, but this is my first love.
I'm around thirty and finally in love.

title.native: アラサーだけど、初恋です。

106984.description:
After the manufacturing company of R-18 dating sims undergoes dissolution, an obsessed 30-year-old virgin visits a deserted shrine and requests to be sent to the world of their masterpiece, Kokorone Heartful.

Although his wish is granted, the god mistakenly turns him into the heroine instead of the protagonist. Ordinarily the romancing choices are left to the protagonist. However, unless he completes the game as the heroine, he will be forced to remain in Kokorone Heartful as a woman forever.

title.native: ただし俺はヒロインとして

106985.description: Kanbayashi’s fallen for Toyo-san since he got picked up. Even though he wants them to be together forever, Toyo-san is always cold. “Maybe we’re just friends with benefits? Whatever, I’ll just service you with my ero techniques to become your lover…”
synonyms: あまあまに染まる（表題作　甘える爪痕)

106986.description: A black-haired girl visits a rental shop to flirt with the clerk, who goes along with it as a joke.

106987.description: Hikari Hayakawa switched bodies with a wanted criminal, and is being chased down by the police.

106988.description:
Once upon a time in the city of Kobe, there was a girl and a boy. Both lived under abusive households, and the two swore an oath to be together until death. However, they are quickly separated, seemingly forever. That is, until a chance encounter reunites them three years later...

Note: Includes 7 bonus chapters.

106989.description: A spin-off of Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon focusing on Lucoa and Shouta.
synonyms: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid: Lucoa is my xx

title.native: 小林さんちのメイドラゴン　ルコアは僕のｘｘです
title.romaji: Kobayashi-san-chi no Maidragon: Lucoa wa Boku no xx Desu

106990.description:
A story that takes place in a great continent grounded on the skeletal bones of a phoenix that is inhabited by many nations and people. Suddenly in the region to the West, seven volcanoes that have been inactive for centuries begin to erupt and its fire burns a blanket of red that is large enough to covers the sky, blazing across heaven and earth.

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

106991.description: Once a proud woman, she was taken away by a crime syndicate and her memories erased. A fiery playboy will become a cool and calculated police detective to search the world for her. Fate conspires to finally bring them together again. When their memories awaken, will they find happiness, or sink into the abyss?

106992.description:
The childhood sweethearts who lived in a small city ten years ago met again in a big city ten years later. The difference between identity class, domestic violence and bullying, inspirational growth and abusive love... But luckily, there are roses and sugar under the knife and glass, and maybe the two of them will have a happy ending after all?

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: My Obsession Won't Let Me Leave

106993.description:
Nanaka Kasumi works at her uncle's coffee shop. She can't stop thinking about Akiyoshi, a regular customer who's sensitive and quiet. One day, Akiyoshi, whose family runs a flower shop invites her to a wrestling event where he says he'll be working. Nanaka thinks it's strange that he asked her to go and watch wrestling, even if he happened to be delivering flowers to the venue, but she arrives there believing he'd invited her out on a date. The match is seething with violence as a barbaric challenger fights in the ring. Then suddenly, she's swept off her feet by him! And when he pulls of the mask, who does he turn out to be, but...! "There's a rule that when when a woman discovers the identity of a masked wrestler, she has to marry him." Is that pushy or what...!?

(Source: Renta!)

106994.description:
Rena takes her work seriously, but she doesn't get along with her curt boss, Mr. Odagiri. One day, she sees him smile and now she can't stop thinking about him. Even though he's strict, he has a cute side and he pays attention to her... She loves his soft side that he doesn't show to anyone else. He kisses her and whispers in her ear, "If you're interested, I'll teach you." In bed, he shows yet another secret, beastly side of himself... This is a sweet, erotic love story between a girl and her cool boss.
(Source: Renta!)

title.english: My Cool Boss Is a Beast in Bed!?
title.native: クール上司はえっちなケダモノ！？
title.romaji: Cool Joushi wa Ecchi na Kedamono

106995.description:
"My body is filled with poison..." The first man that Seika falls in love with in the purest way possible is a researcher that she calls Doctor Ryo. Growing up in a small enclosed world, he was the first person to make her happy both as a person and as a woman. With him by her side, she can do anything. She can even wander the night and use her body to transmit poison to its intended victims. The problem is, no matter how strongly she feels for Ryo, she can never touch him because of the poison she carries. The bittersweet mystery you've been waiting for starts now.
(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: Aisuruhito ni Furerarenai: Kindan no Hana

title.english: Unable to Touch the One I Love -The Forbidden Flower-
title.native: 愛する人に触れられない~禁断の花~
title.romaji: Aisuru Hito ni Furerarenai: Kindan no Hana

106997.description:
Flum Apricot was never meant to be a hero. Despite zero stats across the board and a power she can’t even use, she somehow finds herself included in a party of heroes. But Flum’s life hits rock bottom when the party’s renowned sage, Jean Inteige, decides that the useless girl is dead weight, and arranges to have her sold into slavery. Tossed to monsters to be feasted upon for her master’s entertainment, Flum makes the desperate choice to reach for a cursed weapon…and something new awakens within her. A grimdark tale about one woman’s blood-soaked quest to reclaim her life!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: กระจอกอย่างแกยังไงก็แพ้จอมมาร
"너 따위가 마왕을 이길 수 있다고 생각하지 마”라며 용사 파티에서 추방되었으니 왕도에서 멋대로 살고 싶다

title.english: ROLL OVER AND DIE: I Will Fight for an Ordinary Life with My Love and Cursed Sword!
title.native: 「お前ごときが魔王に勝てると思うな」と勇者パーティを追放されたので、王都で気ままに暮らしたい
title.romaji: "Omae Gotoki ga Maou ni Kateru to Omou na" to Yuusha Party wo Tsuihou Sareta node, Outo de Kimama ni Kurashitai

106998.description: A love story of two girls who met on the train to school.

title.native: 明日また会いましょう

106999.description:
Since ancient times, Hyakumonogatari has been the name given to a certain collection of 100 mysterious tales — tales in which monsters are sure to appear! 
This manga is a compilation of ninety-nine stories, drawn and narrated by Hinako Sugiura – acclaimed manga artist and researcher of the Edo period.
